notes.title: Online Training Update
notes.content:
[h2]Features:[/h2][list]
[*] Optimized training saving
[*] Online training - upload your training and play trainings created by other players.
[*] Leaderboards - compete with other players for higher rank in leaderboards.
[*] Maps reworked
[*] Training editor updates - rank by option & more
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2][list]
[*] Delayed laser 
[*] Wrong coloring in training editor 
[*] Camera clipping in third person view
[*] Guns UI not aligning
[*] & More
[/list]

notes.title: Level Editor Update
notes.content:
[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[h2]AI Training Editor - Build a map with obstacles, enemies and teammates in it. [/h2]
[*][h3] Obstacle[/h3] - Pick a shape, resize, change color and choose the purpose of the obstacle.
[*] [h3]Enemy and Teammate[/h3] - Choose a shape, gun, define speed, health points, accuracy, and behavior.
[*] [h3]Player[/h3] - Define speed, weapons and health points.
[*] [h3]Edit tool[/h3] - Remove, modify and copy objects.
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Feedback - Write a quick review or report a bug.[/h2]
[*][h3]Review[/h3] - Rate using stars, write what you like, dislike and what would you like in future updates.
[*] [h3]Bug Report[/h3] - Pick a scene in which the bug occurred, describe the bug and list the steps to reproduce it.
[/list]

notes.title: Settings Update - 0.8.1
notes.content:
[h1]Features:[/h1]
[b]Settings menu[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed UI
[*] More video settings - texture quality, shadow quality, shadow distance, antialiasing, post-processing
[*] More music and sounds - 12 new tracks
[*] Improved sensitivity convertor - more games (Apex, Fortnite, Cs:Go, Overwatch, Paladins, QCDE, Rainbow 6 Siege, Quake)
[*] More third-person settings - FOV, scoped FOV, camera distance
[*] More - auto sprint, show weapon models, replays, show damage, show health points
[/list]
[b]Changed training colors [/b]

notes.title: Update 0.8.0
notes.content:
[b]Training Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Training saving - Save multiple trainings
[*] Optimized loading and saving
[*] New preview option - customize training in real-time
[*] Reduced to one (follow and sniper training removed)
[*] Increased max enemy count to 30 enemies
[*] New spawn shapes - circular and surrounding
[*] More customizable custom spawn
[*] Improved enemy movement settings (navigational movement and more advanced options)
[*] Added health customization for enemies
[*] Player movement
[*] Moving spawn
[*] Destroy after time option
[*] Customizable guns
[*] Scoring settings
[*] End game settings
[/list]
[b]Changed SMG to Laser[/b]
